statement: let Λ := ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt; ∀ Y : ℕ, ((Finset.range (Y+1)).filter (fun n => (Nat.sqrt n).Prime ∧ n = (Nat.sqrt n)^2)).sum (fun n => Λ n) ≤ Real.log 4 * Real.sqrt Y

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · Levent GRH 与自然推广 · TP-0055 · 给真素数平方的对数权分配平方根预算
plain_statement.en: New route · Levent GRH methods and extensions · TP-0055 · Bound the log mass of prime squares by a square-root budget

brief.zh: 平方位置按底素数唯一重排。Λ(p²)=log p，再用 Chebyshev.theta 的上界。该预算保留了一重对数权，供差二短窗的污染估计。
brief.en: Index the squares by their unique prime bases. Use Λ(p²)=log p and the upper bound for Chebyshev.theta. Keep the single log weight for the gap-two error.
